newsitem.title: GERMANY: German PWO to buy 49 pct of Canada's Brattan Tool.
newsitem.headline: German PWO to buy 49 pct of Canada's Brattan Tool.

text.p: German machinery firm PWO AG said on Wednesday that it would buy a 49 percent stake in the family-owned Canadian company Brattan Tool Industries and planned an eventual takeover of the group.

In a mandatory statement, PWO said its acquisition of the 49 percent stake would take effect on January 1, 1997 and that it had signed an agreement to increase its ownership to 69 percent within three years.
The Canadian firm has annual sales of around 20 million Canadian dollars and 120 employees, PWO said.
PWO also said it had signed an agreement with the Michigan-based group L&W Engineering Co to co-operate on developing and producing dashboard supports.

The German group said it had increased its own sales by 22 percent in the first nine months of its current business year to 140 million marks. The growth was due to growth in sales of new products for the car industry.
Sales should reach 176 million marks for the full year, matching a record set in 1991, PWO said.
